createdReferences.purpose: Project-owned paintover to exaggerate body, neck, folded-forelimb, and dorsal feather signals on the current app candidate.
Hand-authored diagnostic control guide with explicit feather masses, folded wing-like forelimbs, long tail, and sickle-claw intent.

summary: Project-owned feather references were created and tested through IP-Adapter + ControlNet. The references are useful infrastructure, but generated outputs still failed the dromaeosaur_feathered training gate because surface texture remained stripe/scaly, folded forelimb feathers were weak, and leg/grounding errors persisted in several candidates.
primaryRejectReasons: generated surface texture still reads as stripes or scales rather than dense downy plumage
folded forelimb feathers remain too weak
some candidates introduce extra limb or grounding artifacts
feather-mass guide can stabilize shape but does not force feather material in RealVisXL
nextRoute: Keep the project-owned references, but add either a feather-aware checkpoint/LoRA branch or a more direct image-editing step that turns the app candidate into convincing plumage before using it as a training seed.
